cases.input: One protocol is implemented by several products.
cases.expect: The technology remains one abstract capability with external product mappings.
cases.violates: One technology may map many-to-many to products.

cases.expect: The sourced lifecycle changes without mutating local adoption.
Both identities and the successor assertion remain resolvable.

cases.input: A vendor product is used as technology identity.
A deployment outage marks the technology obsolete.
The technology inherits one product license.
cases.violates: Technology never inherits producer or license.

cases.input: An upstream community asserts deprecation, naming the asserting body and the observation instant.
cases.expect: The assertion is retained with asserting party and observation time while taxonomyStatus is unchanged.

cases.input: A single status field is set to obsolete from an upstream notice and then read as the taxonomy state.
cases.expect: The conflation is rejected; taxonomy status and upstream assertion are separate fields.
cases.violates: (added:) Taxonomy status and upstream lifecycle assertions are separately recorded.

cases.input: An upstream lifecycle change is recorded with no asserting party and no observation time.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected and the upstream state remains unknown.
cases.violates: (added:) An upstream lifecycle assertion without asserting party and observation time is not recorded and the upstream state remains unknown.

cases.input: A vendor end-of-support date is recorded on the technology record.
cases.expect: The placement is rejected; vendor support status is outside the technology boundary.
cases.violates: (added:) Vendor support status and end-of-support date are excluded from Technology.

cases.input: A technology is mapped to a deployed instance through the operator-side deployment boundary.
cases.expect: The reference resolves to the evidenced deployment boundary and carries the prior-research-only hold.

cases.input: A boundary reference names a registry identifier that appears in no admitted evidence.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected as an unevidenced identifier.
cases.violates: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

cases.input: The taxonomy steward approves an adoption transition and signs an exception grant.
cases.expect: Both acts are rejected; the steward holds no governance authority.
cases.violates: (added:) The taxonomy steward is never a producer, vendor or subject owner, and confers no authority to adopt, assess, grant or waive.

cases.input: A technology record names its taxonomy steward and no approver.
cases.expect: The steward is retained as a catalogue role with no authority implied.
cases.violates: (added:) The taxonomy steward is never a producer, vendor or subject owner, and confers no authority to adopt, assess, grant or waive.
